description: Get every documented OEM replacement part for one known laptop model, with constraints and the official source URL for each fit. Use it when you know the model (slug from list_models or resolve_request, or a model name); use resolve_request first for a vague request, get_part or get_part_fits when you start from a part number, and get_coverage just to see which part types a model has. An ambiguous name (e.g. "T14") returns status "ambiguous" with candidates: ask the user to choose, then call again with the slug. With 2+ documented screens, panel_options says how they differ: tell the user to check their current panel part number or connector. Each part has lpf_url and buy_links (follow buy_links_hint); each fit has confidence oem_manual, retailer or unverified.

client.description: Optional: your agent or app name (letters and digits), used only for anonymous usage counts.

limit.description: Optional page size: default 25 (50 with view compact), max 100. Without limit or cursor every part is returned.

type.description: Optional part type filter, e.g. Battery

view.description: compact = part number, type, confidence, lpf_url, constraints, source only

name: get_model_parts

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

title: Get parts for a model
